description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gleaming Barrier, adding {C}{C}.
Gleaming Barrier, Mortuary, and Korvold triggers.
Resolve the Gleaming Barrier, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger by putting Gleaming Barrier on top of your library.
Resolve Korvold's second ability trigger by putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Cast Gleaming Barrier by paying {2}.
Repeat.
